## Requirements

The Plotgardener App requires **macOS** (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3 or
Intel). Windows and Linux are not supported at this time.

<div style="margin: 2em 0;">
  <a href="https://github.com/rishabhsvemuri/ThePlotgardenerApp/releases/download/v1.0.0/plotgardener-1.0.0.dmg"
     class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">
    <i class="fab fa-apple"></i>&nbsp; Download for macOS
  </a>
</div>
<p><a href="https://github.com/rishabhsvemuri/ThePlotgardenerApp/releases">View all releases →</a></p>

## Installation

The Plotgardener App is distributed as a single `.dmg` file that bundles
all prerequisites — including a self-contained R environment — so no
separate R or package installation is required.

1. Download the latest `.dmg` from the
   [releases page](https://github.com/rishabhsvemuri/ThePlotgardenerApp/releases/download/v1.0.0/plotgardener-1.0.0.dmg).
2. Open the `.dmg` file and drag the Plotgardener App into your
   **Applications** folder.
3. On first launch, macOS may display a security prompt. If so, go to
   **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
4. Open the app and start building.

## Verifying Your Installation

Once the app is open, you should see the four-tab interface (Page,
Plots, Save, Code) alongside a figure preview pane. To confirm
everything is working:

1. Click the **Page** tab and enter a page width and height (e.g.,
   5 x 5 inches).
2. Click the **Plots** tab, select a function from the dropdown (e.g.,
   `plotRect`), and confirm that parameter fields populate automatically.
3. Fill in the required parameters and click **Add Plot**.
4. Click **Run Script** — the preview pane should render the figure.

If the preview renders successfully, the app is installed and working
correctly. For a full walkthrough of each tab, see the
[User Interface](plotgardenerApp_ui.html) guide.
